PIRM.tag: FEBRAS ACADEMY ARCHIVE // CLASSIFICATION: SOVIET SCIENCE (DEPT-4)
PIRM.title: Pogranichny Institute of Relativistic Mechanics (PIRMGD)
PIRM.fullName: Пограничный институт релятивистской механики и геокосмической динамики (Pogranichny Institute of Relativistic Mechanics and Geo-Cosmic Dynamics)
PIRM.cyrillic: Пограничный институт релятивистской механики [pəgrɐˈnʲit͡ɕnɨj ɪnstʲɪˈtut rʲɪlʲɪtʲɪˈvʲisːkəj mʲɪˈxanʲɪkʲɪ] (ПИРМ [pʲiːrm])
PIRM.registration: Far East Branch, [ussr] Academy of Sciences (FEBRAS)
PIRM.body:
The **[pogranichny] Institute of Relativistic Mechanics and Geo-Cosmic Dynamics** (commonly designated [pirm] or [pirmgd]) is a flagship joint Sino-Soviet research institution located on the frontier border in [pogranichny].

Established through a bilateral partnership between the Soviet and Chinese Academies of Sciences, the institute was created to push the boundaries of modern physics. Its departments focus on fundamental gravitational research, relativistic mechanics, high-energy astrophysics, and theoretical spacetime geometry.

Under the directorship of [professor:upper] [stanislav_krotov], the facility serves as a major scientific hub—bringing together Soviet researchers, Chinese scholars, and international fellows to conduct collaborative experiments, develop advanced computational models, and publish groundbreaking theoretical work.

Ripple Sickness.tag: USSR MINISTRY OF HEALTH // CLINICAL BULLETIN NO. 88-B
Ripple Sickness.title: Pathology of Post-Ripple Neuropathy (Ripple Sickness)
Ripple Sickness.body:
**Clinical Manifestations:** Following the [time_ripple] incident this year, affected individuals demonstrate sensory desynchronization, severe episodic migraines, and intrusive cognitive flashes commonly referred to as [ripple_sickness].

State polyclinic [doctor:plural] evaluate these anomalies as micro-structural degradation along synaptic [neural_pathways], resulting in chronological perceptual delay.

**Therapeutic Directives:** Standard medical dispensaries issue scheduled sedatives and anti-hallucination [medication]. Patient response is frequently refractory, prompting ongoing pharmacological reviews across regional medical commissions.

ROVD.tag: USSR STATE DIRECTORY // LAW ENFORCEMENT & PUBLIC SECURITY
ROVD.title: District Department of Internal Affairs (ROVD)
ROVD.fullName: Районный отдел внутренних дел (District Department of Internal Affairs)
ROVD.cyrillic: Районный отдел внутренних дел [rɐˈjonːɨj ɐdˈdʲel vnʉtrʲɪnʲɪx dʲel] (РОВД [ˈɛr ˈo ˈvɛ ˈdɛ])
ROVD.jurisdiction: Municipal & District Level // Ministry of Internal Affairs (MVD)
ROVD.body:
A **District Department of Internal Affairs** ([rovd]) is the standard territorial police precinct and municipal investigative headquarters operating across districts under the Ministry of Internal Affairs (MVD).

**Role & Organization:**
Established across urban and rural administrative districts throughout the [ussr], the [rovd] oversees public safety, municipal order, and criminal investigations. Each precinct houses uniformed *Militsiya* patrol units, criminal detectives, and forensic specialists responsible for local law enforcement.

Precincts operate continuous 24-hour duty desks to manage citizen reports, emergency dispatches, and public inquiries.

WSS.tag: CENTRAL EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE // HISTORICAL ARCHIVE NO. 2050-WSS
WSS.title: World Socialist Society (WSS)
WSS.organization: International Collective Council of Socialist Nations
WSS.body:
The **World Socialist Society** ([wss]) is the premier international collective body representing unified socialist nations across Earth. Founded in **2050** following the global realization of post-scarcity basic necessities, the organization functions as a worldwide cooperative forum to coordinate international diplomacy, scientific cooperation, and shared planetary resources.

Rather than acting as a direct governing state, the [wss] [help:present_singular] facilitate multilateral accords, standardizes global technological infrastructure, and oversees collaborative development between sovereign member nations.

hints.title: Stage 1: Orientation
hints.text: Are you unsure where or when this case takes place? Which clues in the scene show a calendar date, an anniversary announcement, or navigation coordinates?

hints.title: Stage 2: Chronology & Timeframe
hints.text: How do the dates stamped on the used medical bottles compare to the date shown on the morning phone screen? How much time has elapsed between the first bottle and today?

hints.title: Stage 3: Motive & Route
hints.text: Look at the phone messages and the outgoing voicemail. If the protagonist called in sick to his workplace, why is his navigation leading him in a completely different direction, and what made him reconsider his condition?
